Court of Justice of the European Union

Summary

The case concerns the intersection of data protection and artificial intelligence regulation.

Grounds

1. The applicant argues that the AI system processes personal data in violation of Article 46 of Regulation 2016/679.

2. Furthermore, the system is classified as high-risk under Article 3 of Regulation 2024/1689.

3. The Court must consider both regulatory frameworks in its assessment.

Operative part

The Court rules that both Article 46 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 and Article 3 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 apply to the system in question.
